_purpose: Per-function allow-lists for port_forge/tools/pf_win32_recovery_audit.py (carrier/scripts/recovery_audit.py), the global-reference/magic-divide audit generalized from the ad-hoc checks that caught Divergence 010 (carrier/NOTES.md, notes/living_record.md). Every entry below is a MEASURED, understood difference between play()'s original disassembly and its recovered src/icytower/play.c, not a guess -- see '_evidence'. Adding an entry here without matching evidence defeats the audit; do not copy an entry to a new function without re-deriving its own evidence. Entries removed since this file was first written (ctrl.use_joy, map.empty, summary_scroller.horizontal, swap_screen.w, ply.x) are now resolved automatically by the tool's own provenance/alias tracking and no longer need an allow-list -- see the tool's git history for what changed.

_evidence.ply.y+4/ply.sx+4/ply.sy+4: read the high 32 bits of a Tplayer double field (y offsetof 8, sx/sy offsetof 16/24) directly -- a sign/exponent bit-trick the ORIGINAL MSVC compiler chose for a fast comparison, recurring across play() and every collision handler that compares player position/velocity. The recovered source writes the same comparison as an ordinary `double` compare; GCC does not reproduce the trick. play()'s own instance is in-vivo verified byte-identical over the full human_test/.itr replay (carrier/NOTES.md Divergence 010 SS5) -- collision/physics is unaffected by construction, same digest.
_evidence.swap_screen.vtable: Allegro's vline()/hline()/etc. macros expand to `bmp->vtable->fn(...)` at COMPILE TIME in the original build (Allegro's own headers, not this project's code); a recovered function calls the higher-level drawing functions instead, without literally naming `.vtable`. A macro-level difference, not a functional one -- recurs in every function that draws (play(), fadeOut(), draw_frame()).

_evidence.options.msc_volume/snd_volume, profile.f: three physically separate `profile->{flash,jump_hold,msc_volume,snd_volume} = options.{...}; save_profile(profile);` blocks inlined in play()'s original bytes (one per pause-loop's ESC-quit path: VA ~0x4139f3, ~0x413e17, ~0x41449f). The recovered source reaches the SAME assignments + save_profile call exactly once, via syncProfileFromOptions()+save_profile(profile) after the shared tick-loop exit (play.c 'end of the tick loop' section) -- all three pause loops set quit/playing and fall through to that one shared call, so the end state is identical regardless of which path triggered it. Measured: carrier/NOTES.md Divergence 010 SS5 records G1-G5 all EQUAL and human_test/.itr replays byte-identical post-fix; this pass re-ran human_test.txt with play=src and got the same 2293/2293-tick EQUAL verdict. Consolidated by the recovery, not re-inlined 3x.
_evidence.demo.data: single site: the original takes &demo->data once ahead of a loop the recovered source re-evaluates demo->data[i] per iteration; same data, different codegen shape.
_evidence.demo.key_flags: `k = demo->data[i].key_flags;` (play.c ~line 326) is a TWO-hop dereference (demo -> data[i] -> key_flags) -- this tool's provenance tracker follows exactly one hop (see pf_win32_recovery_audit.py's own extract_refs docstring); a second hop is a known, documented scope limit, not investigated further.
_evidence.profile.ccc/profile.jc: profile->ccc[i-1]/jc[i-1] compared against p->ccc[i-1]/jcTop[i-1], immediately after profile->cccNum/cccTotal (which THIS tool's provenance tracker does resolve, a few lines earlier in the same block). Provenance for the `profile` register is lost across the intervening comparison/branch by this tool's linear, no-branch-following heuristic -- a known scope limit (see module docstring), not a functional claim; not investigated further given carrier/NOTES.md Divergence 010's own extensive in-vivo verification of this exact function.

_evidence.custom.h: custom.frame[curr_char]->h -- a TWO-hop dereference (custom -> frame[i], a BITMAP*[15] member, -> ->h, the BITMAP's own height field); this tool's provenance tracker follows exactly one hop (known scope limit, see extract_refs' own docstring).
_evidence.demo.cycle_count: single site; not investigated further given the scale of this pass -- flagged here rather than silently dropped.
_evidence.demo.name: demo->name (a char[] field, Treplay offsetof 12) passed to sprintf/textout_ex/text_length; the address computation (`lea`) or the register carrying `demo` across these several calls is not resolved by this tool's one-hop, no-branch-following provenance heuristic in this specific, very large (8518-byte) function.
_evidence.map.empty: map.room[i].empty accessed through a runtime loop index in both forms, same class as play()'s own former map.empty finding (map.c's PROMOTIONS.md entry, offline-oracle-verified separately).
_evidence.map.room: same map.room[i] access, the reverse direction (source names it, this tool's original-side resolution does not reach the same leaf) -- see map.empty above.
_evidence.ply.angle: single site; not investigated further given the scale of this pass.
_evidence.demo.key_flags: same TWO-hop dereference (demo -> data[i] -> key_flags) as play()'s own entry -- see play's own _evidence.

_evidence.profile.handle: The ORIGINAL reaches this member THROUGH THE POINTER, so no absolute address for it exists to match: 0x40781a loads the `profile` global (a `Tprofile *` @0x4dd27c) into %eax and 0x40781f does `add $0x6,%eax` -- `handle` is at offsetof 6 -- before passing it to stricmp against the literal "guest" at 0x4d4b86. The audit resolves the POINTER (`profile`, matched on both sides) but the +6 is register arithmetic, not a reference the address scan can see. src/icytower/results.c spells the same thing as `stricmp(profile->handle, "guest")`. Independently verified: batch15b_check.py traces that stricmp call with BOTH argument strings and its result, EQUAL over 12000 vectors x 4 seeds (PROMOTIONS.md batch 15, finding 6).

_evidence.menu_params.ctrl / menu_params.use_joy: One address, two spellings -- a NESTED-STRUCT naming difference, not a member difference. `Tmenu_params` is {FONT *font; int font_height; Tcontrol ctrl; ...}, so `menu_params.ctrl` is at menu_params+8 == 0x4f8e40; `Tcontrol`'s first member is `use_joy` at offsetof 0, so 0x4f8e40 is ALSO `menu_params.ctrl.use_joy`. The audit flattens the path to `menu_params.use_joy` and drops the intermediate struct name; src/icytower/alert.c passes the address of the whole substructure, `&menu_params.ctrl`, exactly as the object code does (0x40d280, 0x40d294 and nine more sites all push the bare 0x4f8e40 into poll_control/is_any/is_left/is_right/is_fire/is_enter). The counts agree exactly (11 and 11), which is what says the two names are the same eleven sites. Independently verified: batch15b_check.py traces every one of those calls with its Tcontrol argument rendered as a stable symbol, EQUAL over 4000 vectors x 4 seeds.
